details.properties: Flexible thermoplastic elastomer that combines rubber-like elasticity with plastic durability. Recovers its shape after being stretched or compressed.
details.applicability: Highly versatile mater, however, limitations like its lower stiffness and yield strength compared to rigid filaments like PLA or ABS make it unsuitable for structural parts under heavy loads.
details.printing: Nozzle around 200°C, bed near 50°C. Keep print speed slow and cooling low.

details.properties: Strong and lightweight. Combines the toughness of nylon with the stiffness of carbon fibers.
details.applicability: Designed for demanding applications that need high strength and stiffness at low weight.
details.printing: Abrasive, so a hardened steel nozzle is essential. Nozzle around 260°C, heated bed near 80°C to reduce warping.

details.properties: Prints look and feel like real stone. The stone powder makes the filament heavier and more abrasive than standard PLA.
details.applicability: Excels when the goal is a realistic stone texture.
details.printing: Use a hardened steel nozzle. Nozzle around 210–220°C, bed near 55°C.

details.properties: Very test feels like test, xy but also z
